instruction: Browse Disney Princess toys for kids and sort by lowest price.

metadata.explanation: Task requires browsing Disney Princess products in Kids/Toys category and sorting by price low-high (S=4). Maintains same complexity and interaction pattern as original spider-man task. Uses existing evaluator framework without custom functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: Disney Princess category, Toys category, Kids filter, and Price Low-High sort
Multi-pronged verification strategy using both HTML elements (breadcrumbs, sort selector) and URL parameters (keywords, S=4 parameter) provides robust validation
Getter logic (get_active_tab_html_parse with category 'class&url') correctly extracts both page elements and URL information
Metric (check_direct_json_object) appropriately compares boolean values for each requirement
Case-insensitive matching and 'is_other_exist' check for unexpected filters enhance reliability
Complete coverage: all four aspects of the instruction are verified (Disney Princess, Toys, Kids, sort by price)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The evaluator relies on Kohl's website class names (pmpSearch_breadcrumb, sbSelector) which may change if the site is redesigned, but this is acceptable for web automation tasks with assumed stable site structure
Minor: URL parameter 'S=4' for Price Low-High is site-specific knowledge but is correctly configured for Kohl's
